title: The Winter Bridge
author: Mara Marchetti
blurb: Mara Almeida, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent fifteen years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
